title: AndroidAPS is stopped when processing Medtronic pump history
symptom: AndroidAPS is stopped when processing Medtronic pump history. It is 100% reproducible since it started, so AAPS is being restarted every time pump sends history. The log shows an exception: org.joda.time.IllegalFieldValueException: Value 0 for dayOfMonth must be in the range [1,31].
cause: The problem was caused by a BGReceived512 entry in the pump history parsing.
fix: The fix was merged via PR #448, which addressed the BGReceived512 entry issue. A hotfix branch was also created based on master containing all 3 medtronic fixes.
evidence_quote: PR was merged, so this is fixed... Problem was BGReceived512 entry... It should work correctly now...
